protocol.root_selection: one fresh neutral u195450 match per root; first odd-seat Play decision in assigned public hand-count stratum; no policy screening
protocol.source_policy: u195450 all four seats, softmax sampling, declared greedy tribute; full native public prefix
protocol.identity_assignment: pool type assigned at queried node; fixed original pool weights
protocol.hidden_sampler: uniform unseen cards respecting own hand, public holdings and remaining counts; no likelihood weighting of past actions
protocol.primary: weighted identity Brier gain; hidden marginal estimated by cross-product of two independent world means
protocol.secondary: cross-heldout Brier forecast, full-state policy TV and top1 disagreement; 1/4,1/2,full convergence
protocol.confidence: 95% stratified independent-root bootstrap, 5000 draws; same roots/worlds paired across policies
protocol.controls: actual cloned frozen-policy forwards, serial/batch parity, null identity labels, 25% synthetic preference mixture
protocol.scope: frozen CPU inference only; no fitting, optimizer, PPO, main-job interaction or playing-strength claims
